summary: Nearby service names, browsing, peer sessions and a peer mesh exist as SDK models, and network connections are exposed to apps. There is no Wi-Fi Aware pairing, publish or subscribe over a Wi-Fi Aware data path, and no capability query for the radio. Whether the Samsung Tab A8 Wi-Fi chip supports Wi-Fi Aware has not been checked, and nothing has run on a tablet. iPadOS 26.0 and later per the index.
rea_evidence: not captured: REA capture pending (tools/parity/rea-page.sh not run this round; owner rule); facts are from tools/parity/docc.py

features.feature: Service names for publish and subscribe
features.note: ServiceType checks the name; no Wi-Fi Aware service declaration.
Browsing state is modelled; the browse is not a Wi-Fi Aware subscribe.
Peer sessions accept connections; the transport is not Wi-Fi Aware.
No pairing store or pairing exchange.
No query of Wi-Fi Aware support on the host radio.
Generic connections exist; Wi-Fi Aware data paths and performance modes do not.
Scans for unconfigured accessories; a different mechanism from Wi-Fi Aware.

gaps: No Wi-Fi Aware pairing, publish or subscribe data path.
No host capability check for Wi-Fi Aware; tablet radio support is unverified.
